versions.content: {DRAFT} The EthSwtDrv shall provide monotonically in- creasing count values via EthIf_StreamHandleIdxStatistics starting with 0 upon boot up. If the count values are reset by the switch, the EthSwtDrv shall buffer the last read out count values and add them to the count values that were retrieved from the switch.

Status: DRAFT The EthSwt driver shall provide monotonically increasing count values via EthIf_- StreamStatisticsIndication starting with 0 upon boot up. If the count values are reset by the Ethernet switch upon read-out, the EthSwt driver shall return the sum of accumulated count values since boot up and the current count values with each call of EthIf_StreamStatisticsIndication.
